column1: # Cold-staged trees and LaunchAgents against what the Sparkle upgrade path (OSTLER_UPGRADE_MODE) refreshes or installs.
# Generated from install.sh by tests/test_cold_staged_trees_and_agents_have_an_upgrade_path.py; the REASONS are hand-written.
# A new cold-staged tree or agent with no row here FAILS the ratchet. A cold-only row that becomes covered FAILS too: mark it covered.
